verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs mention asynchronous events "when a watchlist gets updated" (alloy-docs-5) and market "perpetual KYC/KYB, AML" checks (alloy-docs-20). Together these imply watchlist screening covering both individuals (KYC) and companies (KYB), but neither describes sanctions screening directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sanctions/watchlist screening, the ability to select specific lists, coverage details for individual vs. company screening, match/hit handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
